newsitem.title: MEXICO: Abaco raises 1996 Telmex EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Abaco raises 1996 Telmex EPS estimate.

text.p: Brokerage Abaco-Rodman said Wednesday it raised its 1996 earnings per share estimate for telephone company Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex).
Telmex's EPS was forecast at $3.526 for 1997, up from $3.418, analyst Claudia Gonzalez said. The brokerage reiterated its "buy" recommedation of the stock.
Abaco-Rodman said the company will use a year-end exchange rate of 7.8509 pesos per dollar.
"Applying this exchange rate will result in an increase of monetary gains, which is a non-cash item related to Mexico's inflation accounting."
The brokerage maintained its 1997 earnings estimates for the company of $3.726 per share.
She said the brokerage estimates a 15-percent increase in international long distance traffic in 1997 and nine percent more national long distance calls.
